limits: Explicit synthetic contact only; no historical war declarations or enemy army AI.
Injury/capture/death, repeated engagement and remote non-recall commands are not yet implemented. Regroup60seconds/morale50 are trial coefficients.
Contact model and animation are engineering trials; numerical balance and nationwide battle performance are not accepted.
Fixed60fps capture is not a realtime performance benchmark.

Only the stated35 GPU checks were rerun: four held-paper cases plus one reply case and representative prior military/entry/transport families, old military/combat, ground and three smokes. Other older cases were not rerun in this slice.

visual_review.method: Viewed native actual Godot screenshots and four decoded chronological video frames; verifier separately checks304 numeric pose pairs and348 exact whole-world/image pairs.
observed: Physical carrier transports all held papers; report reaches unit without disclosing reply to player.
Original-first and retry-first preserve a single formal receipt and unchanged initial loss.
Late failure report after original receipt causes no redundant retry.
Wide models are small and several labels overlap: final HUD polish is not accepted.

16second chronological clip retains180 consecutive live frames. Original automatic montage is preserved, but chronological review omits due-minus-one still after live footage to prevent a backward time jump.
visual_review.scope: 1596 tests and35 GPU processes; only enumerated prior regression cases rerun.
